findings: Reserved IDs were not checked against each other, duplicate definition names silently overwrote earlier values, and Python bool values could be accepted as numeric IDs.
fixes: Validate all emitted scalar IDs as exact integer halfwords, reject duplicate definition names and duplicate reserved IDs within each namespace, and validate rematch trainer halfwords before writing output.
verification: GNU ARM tools on PATH; python -m unittest discover -s scripts -p test_*.py: 63 passed. Original source recovery into a temporary header: 147 definitions and 5 rematch pairs passed.
coverage: Reserved duplicate flags/vars, allocated overlap, legal lower/high variable ranges, upper range exclusion, invalid types/values, cross-namespace name collision and ferry definition collision. Rejected inputs preserve prior output.
limitations: Direct mapped-ID and rematch-ID invalid cases need additional fixtures. Output filesystem-write failure atomicity and all source metadata/linked runtime remain unverified. Temporary recovered header includes newer unrelated variables and is not copied over the branch header.
